name: io.github.bitrovas/mcp
title: Bitrovas L402 Services
description: Lightning-paid (L402) Bitcoin & data tools: PSBT, PoisonCheck, FormatCheck, QR-Bill, Timestamps.

tools.name: bitrovas_services_status
tools.description: Free endpoint: checks api.bitrovas.ch readiness and returns the live machine-readable list of Bitrovas L402 services, pricing in sats, quote endpoints, and input schemas.

tools.name: bitrovas_psbtcheck
tools.description: Pre-sign check of an unsigned Bitcoin PSBT (21 sats via L402). Inspects recipients, amounts, change, fee/sat-vB, RBF, sighash, missing UTXO info, dust, and address-poisoning lookalikes. Returns verdict ok|warn|danger + JSON + DE/EN text. Invalid PSBTs are rejected free (HTTP 400) before an invoice is issued. Call without l402_macaroon/l402_preimage to get the BOLT11 invoice, then retry with the preimage after paying.

psbt.description: Unsigned PSBT v0 in base64 or hex (required).

expected_address.description: Optional expected recipient address to verify against outputs.

expected_amount_sats.description: Optional expected output amount in satoshis (>= 0).

network.description: Optional Bitcoin network: mainnet, testnet, signet, or regtest.

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_psbtcheck_quote
tools.description: Free endpoint (POST /v1/psbtcheck/quote): returns the PSBT-Check price in sats and optionally validates an unsigned PSBT without issuing an invoice or revealing the verdict.

psbt.description: Optional unsigned PSBT v0 (base64 or hex) to pre-validate.

tools.name: bitrovas_poisoncheck
tools.description: Address-poisoning check for Bitcoin, EVM, and Tron addresses (21 sats single; 21 + 5 sats per address for batches up to 50). Compares the address you are about to send to (used) against the known address (expected) to detect lookalike/vanity poisoning patterns. Identical addresses or mismatched networks are answered free (HTTP 400) before invoicing.

used.description: Address to check (string) or list of up to 50 addresses for batch checking.

expected.description: Known correct address (string), or for batch either one string or a list matching the length of used.

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_poisoncheck_ai_status
tools.description: Free endpoint (GET /v1/poisoncheck/ai/<ticket>): retrieves a supplementary AI explanation once if a PoisonCheck review result included ai_explanation.poll.

ticket.description: Ticket ID or /v1/poisoncheck/ai/<ticket> path from ai_explanation.poll.

tools.name: bitrovas_formatcheck
tools.description: Validate CSV, YAML, XML, TOML, or JSON (up to 1 MiB / 1M elements), optionally validate against a JSON Schema (2020-12, local $ref only), or convert to JSON / flat JSON to CSV. Price: 10 sats + 1 sat per started KB (use bitrovas_formatcheck_quote for exact free price). Invalid input is rejected free (HTTP 400).

data.description: Input text to validate or convert (UTF-8, max 1 MiB).

format.description: Input format: csv, yaml (or yml), xml, toml, or json.

action.description: Optional action: validate (default), to_json, or to_csv (requires format=json).

json_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema 2020-12 object (local $ref only, max 8000 bytes).

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_formatcheck_quote
tools.description: Free endpoint (POST /v1/formatcheck/quote): calculates exact byte/KB price (10 + ceil(bytes/1024) sats) and optionally pre-checks syntax/schema without issuing an invoice.

data.description: Input text to measure and optionally pre-check.

tools.name: bitrovas_jsonrepair
tools.description: Validate, syntax-repair (trailing commas, markdown code fences, Python literals), normalize whitespace/NULLs, deduplicate, and optionally JSON-Schema-validate a JSON array of flat records (max 1000 rows, 10 sats via L402).

data.description: JSON array of flat objects, {records: [...]}, or raw JSON/Python-literal text to repair (max 1000 rows).

json_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema 2020-12 applied per row.

json_schema_action.description: Optional action for rows failing json_schema: flag (default) or drop.

options.description: Optional DataCleanBot options (operations, dedupe_keys, dedupe_keep, schema, email_columns, etc.).

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_qrbill
tools.description: Technical offline check of a Swiss QR-bill SPC payload or CH/LI IBAN + reference (10 sats via L402): IBAN checksum, QR-IBAN vs QRR/SCOR/NON, Mod10/ISO-11649 reference, amount/currency, mandatory fields, lengths, character set, and optional expected supplier IBAN comparison (plain or SHA-256).

payload.description: Full Swiss QR-bill SPC payload text (all lines). Required unless iban is given.

iban.description: CH/LI IBAN when checking without full SPC payload.

reference.description: Optional QRR (27 digits) or SCOR (RF...) reference.

expected_iban.description: Optional expected supplier IBAN or list (max 20) to compare against.

expected_iban_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 hex of normalized supplier IBAN (uppercase, no spaces) or list (max 20).

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_timestamp
tools.description: Create a Bitcoin OpenTimestamps proof for a SHA-256 hash or Nostr event ID (21 sats via L402). Returns a pending .ots proof (base64) and an id to poll free via bitrovas_timestamp_status until Bitcoin confirmation (1-12h). Only the hash is sent, never the file.

hash.description: 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of the file. Required unless event_id is given.

event_id.description: Nostr event ID (64-hex, note1..., or nevent1...). Required unless hash is given.

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_timestamp_status
tools.description: Free endpoint (GET /v1/timestamp/<id>): checks whether an OpenTimestamps proof is pending or confirmed on Bitcoin and returns the upgraded .ots proof (base64) and bitcoin_block_height.

id.description: 32-character hex timestamp ID returned by bitrovas_timestamp.

tools.name: bitrovas_adresswaechter_subscribe
tools.description: Watch-only Bitcoin mainnet address or account xpub/ypub/zpub monitoring for 90 days (2100 sats via L402). Every incoming/outgoing transaction (incl. unconfirmed) and address-poisoning dust triggers an encrypted Nostr DM (NIP-17) to npub. Max 5 entries per npub; re-ordering extends by 90 days. Never send seeds or private keys.

target.description: Bitcoin mainnet address (bc1..., 1..., 3...) or account-level xpub/ypub/zpub (depth <= 3).

npub.description: Nostr public key (npub1... or 64-hex) to receive encrypted NIP-17 DM alarms.

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_adresswaechter_info
tools.description: Free endpoint (GET /v1/adresswaechter/info): returns Adress-Waechter pricing, limits (max 5 entries per npub, mainnet only), alert format, and L402 flow.

tools.name: bitrovas_adresswaechter_status
tools.description: Free endpoint: check an Adress-Waechter subscription by subscription_id (GET /v1/adresswaechter/<id>), or recover an order if the initial response was lost by passing l402_macaroon and l402_preimage (GET /v1/adresswaechter/status).

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_walletaddr
tools.description: Watch-only Bitcoin address derivation from xpub/ypub/zpub/tpub/upub/vpub or an output descriptor (21 sats via L402). Derives receive (0/i) and change (1/i) addresses and optionally checks ownership/derivation path for up to 50 addresses. Private keys/seeds are rejected free (HTTP 400).

addresses.description: Optional list of up to 50 Bitcoin addresses to verify against derived chains.

script.description: Optional script override (only with xpub): p2pkh, p2wpkh, p2sh-p2wpkh, or p2tr.

gap.description: Optional addresses per chain to derive (default 20, max 1000).

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_markdown
tools.description: Convert a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, or UTF-8 CSV; max 5 MB) into clean Markdown for AI agents (100 sats via L402). Sandboxed, no OCR/LLM, never stored. Use bitrovas_markdown_quote for a free type/size/price pre-check.

content_base64.description: Document bytes encoded as base64 (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, or CSV).

filename.description: Optional filename (extension must match detected file type).

l402_macaroon.description: L402 macaroon/token returned from an HTTP 402 response on a prior call to this tool.

l402_preimage.description: 64-character hex Lightning preimage obtained after paying the BOLT11 invoice from the 402 response.

tools.name: bitrovas_markdown_quote
tools.description: Free endpoint (POST /v1/markdown/quote): checks supported file types, max document size, 100-sat price, and optionally validates content_base64 or filename/size_bytes metadata without converting.

content_base64.description: Optional base64 document bytes to validate magic type and size.

filename.description: Optional filename for extension check or type validation.

size_bytes.description: Optional byte size metadata to check against limit.
